articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Why Healthcare’s Stock-Market Winners and Losers Could Soon Trade Places. Hospitals and other providers—businesses that make money on volume—thrived. The stock market reflected this divide with brutal clarity. Since early 2020, shares of hospital operator Tenet Healthcare have quintupled while HCA Healthcare has more than tripled.
